## The pedagogy contract (for content changes)

- [ ] Opens with the concrete, not the abstract; plain words over jargon (terms defined on first use)
- [ ] No duplication of existing content — links to it instead
- [ ] Numbers date-stamped if they can rot (prices, specs, sizes)
- [ ] Claims cite sources (field notes → primary reporting; labs → your measured numbers)
- [ ] Ends with "explain it back" / a checkpoint if it's teaching content

## For lab changes specifically

- [ ] The lab runs on a real dataset (or states precisely why simulation is the honest choice)
- [ ] SOLUTION.md numbers updated if the lab's expected results moved
